gcInfo.title: Garbage collection required
gcInfo.message: Deleted manifests are marked for removal. Storage is reclaimed after registry garbage collection.

bulkDelete.title: Delete {count, plural, one {# tag} other {# tags}}?
bulkDelete.typedConfirm: You are about to delete {count} selected tags. Sibling tags sharing the same digest are kept unless selected. Type "{phrase}" to confirm.
bulkDelete.simpleConfirm: This removes {count, plural, one {# selected tag reference} other {# selected tag references}}. Tags sharing the same digest are kept unless you select them too.

tagDelete.title: Delete tag {name}?
tagDelete.withSiblings: This tag shares digest {siblingCount, plural, one {# other tag} other {# other tags}}: {siblings}. Deleting this tag removes only the {name} reference; sibling tags remain until they are deleted separately.
tagDelete.simple: This removes the tag reference from the image. The action cannot be undone.
tagDelete.acknowledge: I understand sibling tags will remain.

imageDelete.title: Delete {kind} {name}?
imageDelete.description: This deletes all {count, plural, one {# tag} other {# tags}} and manifests in this {kind}. Type {phrase} to confirm.
